This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 28, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Palestine weekly: West Bank in flames after Tal killings. Deadly settler attack outside Nablus sets off days of raids, arson, closures and mass arrests. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

2. Israeli settler attack on at-Tuwani. Settler attacks in the occupied West Bank are at record highs. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

3. Sixty Palestinians detained by Israel return to Gaza, describe abuses. The freed men, some in wheelchairs, describe horrific abuses in Israeli detention. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

4. Israeli ex-generals urge Trump to push Netanyahu on 'settler terror'. Settler violence in the occupied West Bank endangers. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

5. Why London's Hackney Council wants to repeal its 'twin' status with Haifa. Green Party, which took over control of the council from the Labour Party, is opposed to Israel's genocidal war on Gaza. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the July 28, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
